Trump considered renaming Atlantic Ocean, Pichai advised against it

Former U.S. President Donald Trump considered renaming the Atlantic Ocean to 'Trump Ocean' after previously renaming Lake Ontario to 'America'. He discussed this idea with Google CEO Sundar Pichai, who advised him against it and explained the reasons. Trump reportedly dropped the idea following Pichai's counsel.
